items.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022
items.q: Gillespie sat in for a good year or two with Latin orchestras so he could be at ease with Latin rhythms.

ctx.x: I should be able to help you out so I’m having one also.

At any rate some very great jazz musicians in their early experiences with Latin rhythm really had very great difficulty, you know, finding the one, finding the pulse. And it took a while to work it out. Gillespie sat in for a good year or two with Latin orchestras so he could be at ease with Latin rhythms. But yeah, I think that these dance rhythms, you have like a more of a universal human pulse to them that helps the music get over, and it makes it easier to listen to the melodic lines if you’re tapping your…
